max-size.name: max-size
max-size.help: Maximum amount of memory that can be used for memory logging in bytes.

full-first-warning-threshold.name: full-first-warning-threshold
full-first-warning-threshold.help: Log full first warning threshold as a percent (1 - 98, default = 75).

full-second-warning-threshold.name: full-second-warning-threshold
full-second-warning-threshold.help: Log full second warning threshold as a percent (2 - 99, default = 90).

full-final-warning-threshold.name: full-final-warning-threshold
full-final-warning-threshold.help: Log full final warning threshold as a percent (3 - 100, default = 95).
